scope: I reviewed exact selected power, analog and control capacitors using public manufacturer data. This report distinguishes nominal component evidence from unproven effective capacitance.
overall_status: Effective-capacitance minima remain open for the listed banks; no public data acquired in this review proves their worst-case DC-bias/aging/temperature bounds.

calculation_policy.aging_caveat: The5% factor is an explicitly chosen screening allowance, not a verified manufacturer aging guarantee or lifetime contract. Listed required-retention factors are finite closure criteria, not passed results.
calculation_policy.bias_caveat: Capacitance at zero bias or nominal dielectric/voltage rating does not establish capacitance at operating bias; separate voltage and temperature effects may interact.

parent_hold_up.basis: FR-A permits25% change from initial after endurance; a680uF initial-low unit could be408uF at20C after that test. Therefore500uF is not guaranteed throughout the advertised endurance solely by the family table.
parent_hold_up.closure: Before capture approval, decide whether the500uF criterion is initial-prototype only or a defined service-life requirement. Obtain exact Panasonic capacitance-temperature/time evidence or qualify measured500uF minimum with the intended replacement interval. If that cannot be met, root must revise the hold-up part/count or bleeder/disable contract and rerun the calculation; this report makes no independent substitution.

other_selected_capacitors.closure: For dVdT/SS timing specifically, derive the waveform from exact low-bias capacitance and time/temperature bounds; bypass nominal alone does not close startup timing.

other_selected_capacitors.scope: 1uF VDDA/VREF, REF3325 input/output and USB limiter
other_selected_capacitors.closure: Confirm exact active ordering suffix and supplier-approved datasheet. Check effective1uF stability/decoupling requirements againstREF3325 andSTM32 hardware guide at3.4V, and USB inrush upper capacitance at5.25V; no curve-based guarantee is claimed.
Exact approval sheet can close value/tolerance andC0Gtemperature/aging without X7R-like bias derating; these are not regulatorminimum-capacitance banks.
Confirm exact suffix/approval sheet andC0G tolerance; feedforward performance still belongs to regulator transient qualification.

finite_completion_steps: Freeze the effective-minimum, maximum, ESR and measurement-condition requirements listed per bank.
Obtain exact manufacturer performance/approval data through a public PDF or human-authorized download; no SimSurfing agreement was accepted here.
Evaluate the exact curves at each listed operating bias and0-50C with initial tolerance and an explicit time/aging contract. Save raw curve data/source revision and the calculation.
Where curves are typical, distinguish engineering-screen pass from production guarantee and measure representative ordered capacitors at actual bias and temperature before approving layout.
If a bank fails, root revises that bank's concrete part/count within regulator maximum-capacitance/ESR limits and repeats startup/hold-up calculations.
